notes.title: PUBLIC DEMO + A NEW FIGHTER
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173796/cd79c856d91698e462cfb8f41b1258be7097fd10.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/cJengyy3F7E"][/dynamiclink]The beloved little pig from the Hundred-Acre Wood surely needs no introduction. Smash pots, trounce on your tail, and touch back down on land when this little piggy comes to market TODAY, free for all players![/p][p]You can [url="https://youtu.be/cJengyy3F7E"][b]watch his announcement trailer here[/b][/url] — and that's right, today is the day [i]Royalty Free-For-All[/i]'s public demo launches on Steam! We're running it through our Playtest branch at the moment, so [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176720/Royalty_FreeForAll/"]visit our store page[/url] and click "Request Access"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173796/370c39854f6d8ccdedd0476c3a0f0c6da8b0a478.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There's only [b]FIVE DAYS LEFT[/b] to [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aaaagames/royalty-free-for-all-a-hand-drawn-public-domain-smashup/"]back the Kickstarter and help us reach our funding goals[/url], and right now we're [u][b]almost 90% of the way there!![/b][/u] Be sure to give the campaign a look and find wonderful backer rewards like behind-the-scenes art books, adorable merchandise packs, and even new fighters that can be made possible by unusually generous donations.[/p]

notes.title: Royalty Free-For-All — CLOSED BETA WEEKEND
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173796/13459e5b4fd5a7c16dc20d924b7e3e737bba8536.png"][/img][/p][p]Royalty rejoice! [i]Royalty Free-For-All[/i] is running a closed beta weekend beginning [b]TODAY![/b][/p][p]If you're one of the [b][i][u]11,000[/u][/i][/b] (wow!!) people who have requested playtest access this month, you'll be able to enjoy a weekend of the complete eight-fighter build of [i]Royalty Free-For-All[/i], FREE![/p][p]If you're one of our many new fans, not to worry—we're holding a wider public demo next week! Stay tuned for more exciting news as it develops.[/p]

notes.title: Royalty Free-For-All is LIVE NOW on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173796/46de58351c21199f1b714d206143cc730f33ef9a.png"][/img][/h1][h1]
[url="http://www.royaltyfreefor-all.com" style="button"]ROYALTY FREE-FOR-ALL IS LIVE ON KICKSTARTER!![/url][/h1][p][/p][p]You heard that right—Royalty Free-For-All is on Kickstarter! Click the button above to find the campaign page.[/p][p][/p][p]Backers can receive incredible rewards like early playtest access, behind-the-scenes art books with developer commentary, and the highest of donations can even introduce [b]new bonus fighters to the game![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QG0S1AWJlzQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The campaign seeks to improve online modes, visual polish, and fund console ports! But stretch goals expand the game's content in phenomenal ways, including [b][u]Arcade Mode[/u][/b], guest music by [b][u]David Wise, Grant Kirkhope, and Evelyn Lark[/u][/b][i], and new fighters like....[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]There's an unbelievable amount of content inside the Kickstarter page — be sure to [u][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aaaagames/royalty-free-for-all-a-hand-drawn-public-domain-smashup/description"]check it out right here[/url][/u]![/h1]
